comment: AETHORAX QGroundControl configuration, read at startup (custom/README.md, 'Configuration'). Copy this folder to <Documents>/<application name>/Config, or point AETHORAX_QGC_CONFIG at one, to change it without rebuilding.

labels.comment: Text in the application, renamed: for each context (the C++ class, or the QML file's name), the original English text and ours.

missionStart.comment: The devices switched on or off at the mission's start, in the first mission item (Initial Settings). Saved in the .plan file as aethorax.initialStatus.<key>. default: the status of a new plan.

takeoff.comment: The tool strip's Takeoff button (renamed in labels). command: the mission command it inserts after the selected item, by rawName; without one, QGroundControl's own Takeoff item.

rightPanel.comment: The Plan view's side panel. Widths are in characters of the application's font, except maximumWidth: a fraction of the window. grip.length is in lines. cursor: a Qt cursor name (Qt::CursorShape), e.g. SizeHorCursor, SplitHCursor, ArrowCursor.
